scope: Git stores source, fixed input lists/configuration, reports, metrics, Run metadata, and hash/verification receipts.
collection_integrity: Each Run preserves transfer.json, _source_manifest.sha256 and the current manifest.sha256. The experiment-level MANIFEST_VERIFICATION.json records the last complete local verification.
byte_preservation: The experiment-local .gitattributes disables line-ending conversion so versioned files retain their recorded source/artifact hashes.

reproduction_requirements.verify_readout.py: Requires the preserved NPZ and paired JSONL artifacts, which are not included in a Git-only checkout.
reproduction_requirements.build_report.py: Requires complete Run evidence, FP32 coefficient+prototype-tail overlays, merged predictions, and the parent study evidence for the cross-study description. Missing data remain unknown.
reproduction_requirements.training_and_evaluation: Requires the official COCO dataset, official checkpoint and pinned runtime. Fixed lists and configuration contain execution-host paths that must be resolved on the reproduction host without changing image identities.
